title: CanonicalArtifact
description: Canonical artifact reference produced by a worker and tracked by the broker. Supports filesystem artifacts and MemPalace drawer references.

job_id.description: Broker job ID that produced this artifact.

run_id.description: Worker run ID that produced this artifact.

path.description: Filesystem path or logical URI to the artifact.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the artifact content, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

schema.description: Schema key or URI used to validate this artifact, if applicable.

palace_drawer_id.description: MemPalace drawer ID when the artifact is stored in the palace rather than on disk.

wing.description: MemPalace wing when artifact_type is palace_drawer_ref.

room.description: MemPalace room when artifact_type is palace_drawer_ref.

retrieval_hint.description: Optional search hint for retrieving the artifact from MemPalace.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp. Null means no expiration.
